answer: Submissions that land within 117 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The vine detector writes to sable, and comet shows every merge. A farm scripting its whole swarm fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 247 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
